=== hocuspocus env ===
PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL=http://web:3000
HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=***
PORT=1234
=== hocuspocus -> web connectivity ===
{"ok":true}
=== register page ===
HTTP 200 final=http://localhost:3020/de/register

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== hocuspocus env ===" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus printenv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'PORT|PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL|HOCUSPOCUS' | sed -E 's/(SECRET=).*/\1***/'; echo "=== hocuspocus -> web connectivity ===" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus sh -c 'wget -q -O - http://web:3000/api/health 2>&1 || echo "wget failed"' ; echo; echo "=== register page ===" && curl -sSL -m 30 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n" -H "Host: app.urbankit.de" http://localhost:3020/de/register
